e: From ayncrap + -ism. See there for more.

A romanization of the sixteenth letter of the Semitic abjads, including Hebrew ע (ʿayin), Phoenician 𐤏 (ʿayin), Aramaic 𐡏 (ʿē), and Classical Syriac ܥ (ʿē), Arabic ع (ʕayn) (where it is sixteenth in abjadi order only).
A romanization of Kazakh аин (aıyn), the Kazakh name for the letter Ғ (Ğ).
From Ayn + crap, by phonological similarity to ancap, from Ayn Rand, who came up with the political philosophy Objectivism, which is closely related to anarcho-capitalism.
